briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: Multiple investigations and allegations of fraud in Minnesota have been reported, including a $21 million Medicaid fraud scheme and a $9 billion Somali fraud investigation. The Minnesota Governor and Attorney General are under investigation for their roles in the Somali fraud investigation. These large-scale fraud investigations suggest a significant problem with fraud in Minnesota, potentially involving multiple entities and government programs. The North Star Watchdog will continue to track these investigations and provide updates as more information becomes available.
